cohort: A single patient at 34 weeks gestation of a twin pregnancy with uncorrected coarctation of aorta undergoing emergency lower-segment cesarean delivery.
finding: A combination of general and epidural anesthesia minimized adverse effects of coarctation of aorta, leading to optimal hemodynamic control and improved maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: For emergency cesarean delivery in a patient with coarctation of aorta, a combination of general and epidural anesthesia led to optimal hemodynamic control and improved maternal and fetal outcomes.
